pages.description: Create a landscape scientific model framework diagram for reservoir property prediction. No overall title. LEFT DOMAIN ANCHOR: compact multi-source evidence consisting of vertical well-log curves, well coordinates, and a small local seismic neighborhood; convert them into a feature table X in R^(B×F). CENTRAL ROUTER: a prominent target router with three lanes PHIF, KLOGH and SW. COOL-BLUE CONFIRMED MAIN PATH: PHIF -> ExtraTrees, KLOGH -> log1p transform -> ExtraTrees -> expm1 inverse transform, SW -> XGBoost. Show each ensemble as multiple small decision trees with aggregated leaves, not as neural cubes. WARM-ORANGE AUDIT SIDE PATH: show TabICLv2 in-context tabular encoder with column attention followed by row attention, rendered as compact 2.5D token stacks; label it audit-only and not promoted. TEAL UNCERTAINTY PATH: development out-of-fold residuals feed a q_0.90 quantile module. Embed the equations y_hat_t = f_t(X), u = log(1 + KLOGH), KLOGH_hat = exp(u_hat)-1, and I_0.90(x) = [y_hat_t - q_0.90, y_hat_t + q_0.90]. RIGHT OUTPUT: three calibrated-style prediction panels with physical units and symmetric intervals, one for PHIF, one KLOGH, one SW. BOTTOM TRAINING STRIP: maternal-well group split -> train-only imputation/scaling and target transform -> target-specific model selection -> out-of-fold residual interval fitting -> frozen known-holdout confirmation. Mark that the known holdout is confirmation only, not a new selection loop. Use X in R^(B×F) and y_hat in R^(B×1). No metric values, no learning rates, no paragraphs.
